changelog: Backtest realism, part 2: replaces one-click 'Place Long/Short' with a real order ticket, and rewrites the position tool's on-chart labels into pill-shaped callouts. This replaces §1 and §4 of the original v3.22.0 briefing (§4/running-trade display is now v3.22.3, unchanged in scope; the original v3.22.4 fees/funding engine is gone, its one surviving piece — the flat-fee charging check — folds into this release).

Part A: btDrawPosition() rewritten from a plain monospace text block into three pill labels — a red Stop pill (outside the box, on the stop edge: price, distance in points and %, and risk $ net of the round-trip fee), a Centre pill on the entry line (neutral grey until a real trade is linked in v3.22.3; shows Entry price and RR), and a teal Target pill (outside the box, on the TP edge: price, distance, and reward $ net of fees). Blue x-axis time pills show the box's start/end times while the tool is selected.

Part B1: the old canvas-drawn 'Place Order' button is replaced by a real floating DOM toolbar above the selected position tool — drag handle, colour swatch, settings (opens the existing popover), Place trade (primary, green-outlined), R:R lock toggle, delete.

Part B2: 'Place trade' (or the sidebar's 'New Trade' panel) opens a docked order ticket at the left of the chart — the chart stays visible while it's open. Long/Short and Market/Limit segmented toggles (switching direction mirrors SL/TP across entry via the existing v3.21.13 btNormalizePositionSides()); Stop Loss required and always on; Take Profit with a 'Keep 3R' checkbox that recalculates TP live as entry/SL move; a %/$ risk switch with an amber 'Off-ladder' note when the entered risk differs from the session's own ladder tier (risk_amount is still recorded as planned either way); a leverage dropdown with live margin required / available margin / estimated liquidation price; live lot size and RR; estimated entry+exit fees. Place Trade is disabled, with the reason shown, for a wrong-side stop, insufficient margin, a liquidation price that would trigger before the stop, or the session's own daily trade cap.

Part B3: full-width entry/stop/TP lines drawn on the existing drawing-tools overlay (not Lightweight Charts' native createPriceLine — the pinned chart version has no line-drag support at all, and every other drawing tool in this file already made the same overlay-canvas call for that reason) — orange dashed for a Limit entry, blue solid for Market (always tracking the live close), red dashed for Stop, green dashed for Take Profit, each with a pill near the right edge. Two-way sync: dragging a line updates the ticket's fields and vice versa, both through one shared state object so neither can fall out of sync with the other; every drag is clamped through the same v3.21.13 side-normalization so no line can cross entry.

Part B4: fee charging was already implemented exactly as specified (backtest_engine.php's backtestFee(), charged independently on entry via fillPosition() and on exit via settleTrade(), both added to trades.fees and deducted via net_pnl) — confirmed, left unchanged, and a standalone self-test case added asserting qty x price x 0.04% x 2 against the real trade-123 calibration shape from v3.22.0.

Schema (migration 2026_09_30_0002): backtest_pending_orders.leverage (NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 — a pending Limit order remembers the leverage chosen in the ticket until it fills, same reason that table already has its own risk_pct column) and trades.leverage (NULLable — only a backtest trade filled from this release forward ever sets it). Margin used is NOT a new column — trades.planned_margin (v3.17.0) is reused for it, per the original v3.22.0 briefing's own 'reuse existing columns' instruction.

BacktestController::placeOrder()/fillPosition() now accept leverage and risk_pct per order (falling back to the session's own defaults when omitted, so the plain sidebar panel's direct calls, if any remain, keep working), and a new checkMarginAndLiquidation() enforces the margin-sufficiency and liquidation-before-stop rules server-side too — not just a ticket-side convenience, matching this app's own standing practice that a real validation rule is never client-only. Two new pure functions in backtest_engine.php (backtestMarginRequired, backtestLiquidationPrice/backtestLiquidationBeforeStop — a deliberately simplified 'full margin wiped out' liquidation estimate, since this app tracks no real exchange's maintenance-margin schedule for any symbol) back both the ticket's live preview and the server's own check, verified with a standalone script to produce identical numbers on both sides.
release_notes: New migration 2026_09_30_0002_add_backtest_order_leverage.sql — 2 guarded ADD COLUMNs, no MariaDB-only syntax. After Update Now, run migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run (in addition to whatever is already pending). Verified via standalone PHP/Node scripts (fee, margin, liquidation, ladder-tier-lookup, side-mirror-on-direction-switch math) and php -l/node --check on every changed file — the actual on-screen rendering, dragging, and toolbar positioning have NOT been verified in a real browser from this environment; see CLAUDE.md's v3.22.1 section for exactly what still needs a live click-through. Next: v3.22.2 (risk-ladder engine), v3.22.3 (running-trade display, Part C of the order-ticket briefing).
